title: Canary Technologies Recognized as a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Awards Winner
summary: Canary Technologies is a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Awards winner, recognized by customers for helping 20,000+ hotels modernize operations with AI.
body_markdown:
*The annual Inc. Power Partner Awards recognize B2B companies that provide essential services and expertise to help entrepreneurs and businesses grow.*


SAN FRANCISCO (October 22, 2026) — Canary Technologies, the leading AI platform for hotel and guest management, has been named a 2026[Inc. Power Partner Awards](https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards) winner, recognizing the company among the leading B2B partners supporting entrepreneurs and businesses across the country.


The annual Inc. Power Partner Awards honor B2B companies that have demonstrated a track record of helping entrepreneurs and businesses navigate the challenges of building and growing a company. From hiring and compliance to technology, infrastructure, fundraising, marketing, and more, these partners provide expertise and services that enable businesses to operate, scale, and pursue their ambitions.


“Business owners have no shortage of tools at their disposal, and B2B companies need to make clear why their products and services are worth the investment,” says Bonny Ghosh, editorial director at Inc. “The companies on this year’s Power Partners list have done just that. They don’t just have customers – they have superfans and evangelists. Across industries like marketing, financial services, and technology, they’ve proved their dedication to helping fellow business owners grow and succeed.”


This year’s winners were chosen in part through customer references, with clients vouching for each company’s products and services. The recognition reflects Canary’s long-standing commitment to modernizing hotel operations, increasing revenue and streamlining the guest experience for more than 20,000 hotels in 125+ countries.


“AI is fundamentally changing what’s possible across industries, and hospitality is no exception,” said Harman Singh Narula, Co-Founder and CEO of Canary Technologies. “At Canary, we’ve always focused on empowering hoteliers with transformative technology that drives meaningful business outcomes and unlocks new possibilities. Being recognized by the customers we serve is a testament to those partnerships and to our team’s dedication to delivering meaningful outcomes for hotels and their guests.”


For more information on Inc.’s Power Partner Awards or to view the complete list of honorees, visit[https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards](https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards) .


**About Canary Technologies**


Canary Technologies is modernizing the hotel tech stack with its award-winning agentic AI platform for hotel and guest management. Digitizing guest touchpoints from discovery to post-stay, Canary manages tens of millions of guest and staff interactions end-to-end autonomously each year, improving operational efficiency, increasing revenue and elevating the guest experience. Canary has built the most robust artificial intelligence interaction layer designed specifically for hotels, staff and guests.


Trusted by over 20,000 hotels in 125+ countries, Canary powers hospitality at the world's most renowned brands, including Marriott International, Four Seasons, Choice Hotels, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, BWH Hotels and IHG Hotels & Resorts. Recognized as the #1 Guest Experience Platform by HotelTechReport for multiple years, Canary has earned recognition from Deloitte, Business Insider, Fast Company, the American Hotel & Lodging Association, TravelTech Breakthrough, Hospitality Technology and more.


For more information, visit[www.canarytechnologies.com](https://www.canarytechnologies.com/) .


**About Inc.**


Inc. is the leading media brand and playbook for the entrepreneurs and business leaders shaping our future. Through its journalism, Inc. aims to inform, educate, and elevate the profile of its community: the risk-takers, the innovators, and the ultra-driven go-getters who are creating the future of business. Inc. is published by Mansueto Ventures, along with fellow leading business publication Fast Company. For more information, visit[www.inc.com](https://www.inc.com/) .
